description: This PHP class implements an interface for integrating with FogBugz via REST API. It includes methods for connecting, retrieving issues and their statuses, checking bug ID syntax, and creating new issues. The class extends an issueTrackerInterface and manages configuration settings for API interaction.

classes.name: fogbugzrestInterface
classes.description: A class that interfaces with FogBugz issue tracking system via REST API, providing methods for connecting, fetching issues, checking status, and creating issues.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the interface, setting configuration and connecting to FogBugz.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes default configuration values if missing.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the API client instance for testing purposes.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks whether the bug ID has a valid syntax.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the FogBugz system using credentials.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to FogBugz has been established.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves issue details such as status and title from FogBugz.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns the verbose status of an issue, equivalent to status code.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Provides the HTML string of an issue's summary.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if an issue exists in FogBugz based on bug ID.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue on FogBugz with a given summary and description.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Returns a template XML string for configuring the FogBugz integration.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Determines if the current configuration allows creating issues via API.
